title: SupportTriage
description: Versioned support-case triage result emitted before any Goobers defect is filed.

schema.description: Version of the support-triage result contract.

disposition.description: Deterministic support routing outcome for the report.

nextAction.description: Recommended next support action; filing remains a separate confirmed mutation.

evidence.description: Safe structured evidence that drove or constrained the disposition.

case.description: Stable support case summary used by intake surfaces.

cluster.description: Support cluster metadata for grouping similar reports.

subject.description: Run, credential, or other structured subject for the evidence.

case.description: Stable support case summary used by intake surfaces.

runIds.description: Run identifiers included in this support case.

workflows.description: Workflow names represented in this support case.

gaggles.description: Gaggle names represented in this support case.

binaryVersion.description: Goobers binary version that collected or produced the evidence.

platform.description: Operating-system and architecture tuple for the producing binary.

fingerprint.description: Stable grouping key derived from safe structured evidence.

cluster.description: Support cluster metadata for grouping similar reports across versions and platforms.

fingerprint.description: Stable cluster fingerprint shared by matching support cases.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of occurrences represented by this triage result.

affectedVersions.description: Goobers versions observed in the cluster.

knownIssue.description: Known issue reference when this cluster maps to a duplicate or known problem.

reproductionAttempts.description: Bounded reproduction attempts already associated with this cluster.
